body_markdown:
For those heading to the Asembia 2026 Specialty Pharmacy Summit in Las Vegas, or anyone hitting town to enjoy the Las Vegas experience, now’s your chance to snap a photo – and get rewarded for it!


We’re excited to announce the **Paysign “Welcome to Our Home” 2026 Sweepstakes** , running **April 24-April 30, 2026** . Paysign branded messaging will be featured throughout Harry Reid International Airport right here in Las Vegas, our home base. If you plan to be traveling through, snap a photo of one of our messages and share it for a chance to win amazing cash prizes!


**Here’s How to Enter**


It’s simple:


1. Find Paysign messaging displayed throughout Harry Reid International Airport, LV
2. Snap a photo – selfies welcome!
3. Post it on LinkedIn using the hashtag[#paysign2026](https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/all/?keywords=%23paysign2026&origin=HASH_TAG_FROM_FEED) .


That’s it – you’re entered!


**Prizes**


We’re giving away a total of **$3,500 in cash prizes** :


- 🥇 **1st Place:** $2,000
- 🥈 **2nd Place:** $1,000
- 🥉 **3rd Place:** $500


**Contest Dates**


Photo submissions are accepted while our airport messages are live, from **April 24, 2026 through April 30, 2026** . Don’t miss your window – one week, big prizes!


**Ready to Enter?**


Start looking for us at Harry Reid International Airport in Las Vegas and get snapping. Share your photo with **#paysign2026** and you could be our next winner!


For full eligibility requirements and contest details, please review the[Official Sweepstakes Rules](https://paysign.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Paysign-Sweepstakes-Official-Rules_20260423v3.html) .


*This contest is open to eligible participants only. See Official Rules for complete details.*
